Oink 0.3.0 adds microphone sharing, finer touchpad and pointer-lock controls, upgrading from a local installer and a new way of receiving files, and improves audio, pairing and screen layout.

## New

- Share a computer's microphone with your other computers.
- When controlling Windows with a Mac touchpad, choose native multi-finger gestures and Mac-style two-finger scrolling independently.
- Set a shortcut that moves the pointer straight to each computer. Hold the configurable escape key to move the pointer off a locked screen temporarily; the lock stays in place when you return.
- Drop a downloaded DMG or MSI into Oink to upgrade from a local installer.
- Rebuilt cross-device dragging and file copying to work with more apps, with improved file transfer and storage.

## Changes

- **Mixed-version groups:** 0.3.0 and 0.2.x computers can still share keyboard, mouse and audio. Clipboard sharing, file copying and file dragging require both computers to run 0.3.0. Upgrade all your computers; a normal upgrade does not require pairing again.

## Fixes

- Fixed held keys such as Tab and modifier keys being released unexpectedly during remote control, and improved input release and pointer restoration after switching computers or cancelling a drag.
- Improved audio continuity during silent gaps, delayed delivery, output device changes and reconnection.
- Fixed a "prepared peer lost" error when pairing again right after the first pairing, and improved pairing after a reset and reconnection within a device group.
- Fixed layout changes that had already been applied being rejected as busy when re-sent after a restart.
- Fixed Windows mirrored displays being reported as an unreadable system arrangement. Arrangement changes now move a mirrored group together and keep it mirrored.

## Downloads

- **Mac:** the `.dmg` file — Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later. Developer ID signed and notarized.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later, or Windows 11. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen runtime (preinstalled on current Windows).

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

## Known limitations

- The Windows MSI is not code-signed in this release. SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run anyway**. UAC shows an unknown publisher.
- Receiving files on a Mac requires the Oink File Provider location to be enabled; if prompted, enable it in Settings → Permissions. Windows skips symbolic links that point to other items in the same transfer; supported Mac-to-Mac transfers keep them.
- Windows users on 0.2.1 need to install the 0.2.2 bridge update before the in-app update can install 0.3.0.
- Downgrading to 0.2.x is not supported once the new received-file store is in use.
